facts.fact: 农场老宅 1894 年建成，是当地最早的宅子之一，一直由爸爸一侧传承。
facts.anchor: Built in 1894, the farmhouse was one of the first in the area and it’s been passed down from Dad’s side ever since.

facts.fact: Molly 霸占 Eden 的房间，两人被塞进小书房的折叠床——「double bed 都是抬举，顶多算加大单人」。
facts.anchor: Double bed might be too generous. A large single if that.

facts.fact: 鸡群以食物命名（Jake 与 Eden 的杰作）：Nugget 会啄人、Schnitzel 最亲人，另有 Parma 与 Kyiv——Oliver 一生没摸过真鸡。
facts.anchor: We have Nugget, Schnitzel, Parma, and Kyiv.

facts.fact: Oliver 修车时说漏嘴：越了解你越爱你——Eden 当场内心双连 What the fuck。
facts.anchor: The more I find out about you the more I love you!

facts.fact: 前男友黑历史：当年偷登她的账号把大学志愿全部删除——「这样我就只剩他一个选项」；幸亏她提交前夜复查。
facts.anchor: he got into my account and removed all of them.

facts.fact: 前男友分手后火速与她的 best friend 在一起——这是她回家只为家人的原因。
facts.anchor: he moved on pretty quick with my best friend.

facts.fact: Jake 的秘密：用 Dad 的车带 Albert Mariano（当年逼爷爷卖地的 council guy）的孙女看星星，以保密换帮忙。
facts.anchor: Because she’s kind of maybe the granddaughter of Albert Mariano.

facts.fact: Jake 安慰：没人因为你上大学而怪你——Eden：「我知道。但有时候感觉就是那样。」
facts.anchor: No one is upset at you because you went to university.

facts.fact: 花园棚野餐上 Eden 护心发言：你的价值不由他们定义——你是她认识最聪明的人之一。
facts.anchor: Your worth is more than anything that they could possibly tell you it is.

facts.fact: 半句告白卡壳现场：And I—I love the time we spend together——love 字出口又被收回后半。
facts.anchor: And I—I love the time we spend together.

facts.fact: 重锤：妈妈是十年前的明天走的——这就是他尽力忘记复活节的原因；「I still think of her every single day」。
facts.anchor: She would have died ten years ago tomorrow

facts.fact: 他许诺：「她一定会喜欢你——一个知道自己要什么、敢去拿的强女人」，并说 I'll take you to meet her one day。
facts.anchor: She would have loved you, you know?

facts.fact: 亭中将吻之际 Oliver 低语「Molly and Charlie are watching」——双胞胎偷看搅局，完美时刻告吹。
